title: Say Hello in the Console
prompt:
Write your first program:

1. Log the exact text `Hello, web!` (with the comma and exclamation mark).
2. Log a second line — any sentence you like — using another console.log.
3. Add a comment above your first log explaining what it does.
boilerplate:
// 1) log "Hello, web!" exactly

// 2) log a second sentence

tests.name: logs the exact greeting
logs a second line
tests.hint: Add a second console.log with any sentence in quotes.

tests.name: includes a comment
tests.hint: A comment looks like: // this logs a greeting
